purpose: Supplement the original native-tilt audit with an explicitly reference-invariant control at the stated 2PN approximation. This does not replace the original study or determine formation-channel fractions.
data_gate: All fixed69 original-prior event sources must have resolved tutorial-row identity and supported prior families before fitting this control.
functional: g = P(chi_eff < 0), a binary-level population probability
mass_redshift: Same fixed target mass, mass-ratio and redshift distributions as the original six-model control; source-frame masses and target redshift support0..2.3.

model.relative_azimuth: Uniform; invariance is conditional on the same isotropic-measure-preserving PN approximation used in the cited spin-reference literature.
model.exact_ties: For a stored x==0 row use the symmetric midpoint, with equal half contributions to the two sign components. Report counts; do not remove rows.
model.normalization: Evenness makes each sign half carry half the normalized base measure at every q,a1,a2; the radial and mass distributions are unchanged.
model.interpretation: A restricted phenomenological sign-asymmetry family with fixed within-half shapes. It can have a density jump at zero for g!=1/2. No universal prior or model-independent measurement is claimed.

selection: Historical O1/O2 semianalytic plus full O3 matched-filter bank
Same bank with cWB union as a paired search-policy control
Constant selection function as an explicitly uncorrected diagnostic, not a valid unbiased population estimate
checks: Independent angular quadrature of normalization and negative fraction, including unequal, equal, small and vanishing spin limits
Invariance of the density ratio along previously validated native-to-infinity source rows; keep any finite PN or release discrepancies
Independent target density and source-prior quadrature on every restored event
Full69-event product versus log-domain posterior and1001/2001 grids
Contribution ESS and largest-weight diagnostics without data-dependent hyperparameter rejection
Finite-bank calibration must remain explicitly conditional; PE-chain correlations and actual campaign coverage cannot be inferred from Kish ESS
limits: Approximate2PN invariance, not exact full-GR spin transport
Historical injection reference itself remains unrecovered
PE likelihood outside its original prior support remains unavailable
O3 high-redshift support and semianalytic early-run assumptions remain
Does not identify physical formation channels or revise the original frozen results
